The '''Shell-cracker prototype''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial R&D|R&D]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. It was developed for [[Project Shell-cracker|Operation: Shell-cracker]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] at [[HM7-R|The Hammer]]. The prototype's purpose was to eliminate enemy starships. It had a complex shield structure containing lattice-like ionic energies designed to disrupt particle and ray shields, and deliver a series of bombs against the target.

It was subject of a [[Operation: Shell Game|raid]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Spec Forces]]. At the time its shield technology was working, but the bombs were not installed.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Shell-cracker appears in "[[Operation: Shell Game (adventure)|Operation: Shell Game]]," the adventure in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beta|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beta]]. If the players manage to take possession of it, the epilogue notes it is seized by [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]].
